# Portable lightbox-gallery

Reusable React ESM package reconstructed from the captured public preview at https://uiarc.dev/components/lightbox-gallery/frame. Preserves delivered behavior, data, styles, motion and captured assets; this is not original TSX.

Import LightboxGalleryDemo from this package and import styles.css. React comes from the consuming app. Build with npm install and npm run build. Arc Pro and dependency licensing remains in force; keep this package private.
